verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style evidence is indirect. Server-side migration involves sending all existing receipts through the POST /receipts endpoint, which appears to work one receipt at a time. Scheduled data exports deliver app data in bulk to storage or email. The MCP server and AI Toolkit let agents manage Products and Entitlements, but nothing shows multi-item operations in one action. Missing for 10: documented batch or bulk endpoints, bulk edit or bulk grant of entitlements across many customers, agent or MCP bulk actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
